drivingQuestion: Why is the bird burnt offering done in the east?

segments.he: מִלְּמַעְלָה: נִיסּוּךְ הַמַּיִם, וְהַיַּיִן, וְעוֹלַת הָעוֹף כְּשֶׁהִיא רַבָּה בַּמִּזְרָח. מַאי טַעְמָא? רַבִּי יוֹחָנָן אָמַר: מִפְּנֵי שֶׁקְּרוֹבָה מִבֵּית הַדֶּשֶׁן.
segments.en: § The mishna teaches that there were three matters for which the portion of the southwest corner «above» the red line served as the proper location: «The water and wine libations, and» sacrificing «a bird burnt offering when» they were «numerous in the east,» i.e., the southeast corner. The Gemara asks: «What is the reason» the sacrificial rites of a bird burnt offering were ideally supposed to be performed at the southeast corner of the altar? «Rabbi Yoḥanan says: Because it is the closest» of all the corners «to the place of the ashes,» i.e., the place where the ashes from the altar are placed every morning. The crop and feathers of a bird burnt offering are placed there as well.
